_comment: Every price carries the date it was checked. Sources are the operator's own
site, the college's own site, National Rail Enquiries' own journey planner,
or Cambridge City Council - no aggregators, no travel blogs.
Fares were read off the National Rail journey planner for a specific date
rather than from a published fare table, so they are 'what the planner
quoted', which is what a reader will see.

trainKingsCross.offPeakReturnNote: Lowest standard return quoted for Tue 15 Sep 2026 out 10:30, back 18:00. The same return was quoted on the 49-minute 10:54 fast train.
trainKingsCross.peakFastTrainNote: The 09:24 fast departure was quoted at £48.10 return on the same day, so the cheap return is not valid on the earliest fast trains.
trainKingsCross.advanceSingleNote: Single quoted for Tue 13 Oct 2026 (a month out); the return for the same day was £30.40, i.e. two of those singles.

trainLiverpoolStreet.greaterAngliaOwnClaim: fastest train time 1h 5m, Advance from £8.00 each way
trainLiverpoolStreet.offPeakReturnNote: Lowest standard return quoted for Tue 15 Sep 2026, and only on the direct Greater Anglia trains; routes changing at King's Cross were quoted £39.30.

contactless.evidence: Greater Anglia's own Cambridge station information page states: 'Oyster cards are not valid at this station'. Cambridge is outside the TfL pay as you go area, which covers London Zones 1-9 and some services just beyond Zone 9.

coach.victoriaService: Service 491, London Victoria Coach Station to Cambridge (Parkside), up to once a day; the page lists first and last daily journey from Victoria as 15:00

driving.motorway: M11; Trinity College directs drivers off at Junction 13 for Madingley Road, or in from the A14 on the Huntingdon Road

parkAndRide.overstay: 18-24 hours £10, 24-48 hours £20, 48-72 hours £30, paid within the first hour via RingGo
parkAndRide.busChildReturn: £1.00, and up to four under-5s travel free with each paying adult
parkAndRide.groupDayTickets: £10 small group (up to 3), £15 large group (up to 5), valid all day in the Cambridge town zone
parkAndRide.payment: Cash or contactless, bought from the driver

cityCentreCarPark.name: Grand Arcade, Cambridge City Council
cityCentreCarPark.blueBadge: Three hours free, badge scanned at the machine

stationToCentre.distance: About a mile, 20-25 minutes on foot
stationToCentre.buses: Stagecoach Citi 1, 3 and 7 serve the station to the city centre; PLUSBUS can be added to a rail ticket
stationToCentre.cycleParking: 2,850 sheltered CCTV spaces at the Cyclepoint

kings.product: King's College Chapel & Grounds - Self-Guided Visit, sold in 15-minute arrival slots
kings.earlyBirdAdult: £16.75 (Sat 19 Sep 2026 slot, booked before the Sunday cut-off)
kings.familyEarlyBird: £43.25 for 1 adult + 2 or 3 children; £59.00 for 2 adults + 2 or 3 children
kings.groupAdult: £16.50 for groups of 15+, one free group leader per 15 paying
kings.earlyBirdRule: The discounted price for a week ends on the Sunday night before it
kings.slots: 09:30 to 16:00 every 30 minutes on the Saturday checked; some afternoon slots are marked 'Closed to visitors' and the pattern differs day to day
kings.noToilets: The college states there are no public toilet facilities on site
kings.chapelServices: Free and open to visitors; no admission once a service has begun; allow up to an hour for Evensong, an hour and a quarter for Holy Communion; bags no larger than airline hand luggage; no photography

trinity.courtsNote: Great Court and the other courts are not open to the public
trinity.guidedTour: £10 per person, under 12s free, card on the day, daily at 10:00 and 14:00, booked in advance, led by the college Porters, meeting at the Great Gate on Trinity Street
trinity.tourCaveat: Some areas may be closed for renovation and the Dining Hall is not currently included
trinity.backs: The Backs, the grounds beside the Cam, are free and normally open 09:00-17:00, but can close for events - phone the Porters' Lodge on +44 (0)1223 338400
trinity.wrenLibrary: Free. Normally noon-14:00 Monday to Friday and 10:30-12:30 on Saturday mornings in term time, entered from Garrett Hostel Lane
trinity.rules: No bicycles, no dogs, no walking on the grass, no picnics or BBQs

stJohns.child: £10 for ages 12-16, reduced to £8 between 25 June and 1 September
stJohns.seniorStudentDisabled: £10 for over-66s, students and National Disability Card holders
stJohns.groupRate: £10 per person, and commercial groups of five or more must be led by a Cantab Tours guide
stJohns.tourismWindow: Paid general entry runs 6 July 2026 to 30 September 2026 only, 09:30-16:30
stJohns.grounds: Grounds open 09:30-16:30, but may close at short notice
stJohns.freeEntry: Alumni and guests, University card holders plus two guests, CAMCard holders plus two guests, Cambridge residents with a CB postcode, prospective students plus two guests, and anyone attending a chapel service or college event
stJohns.payment: Bank card only, no American Express. No re-entry after admission. No dogs except assistance dogs. No bicycles.
closures2026: 11 September 2026 - closed to visitors except Cambridge Colleges Open Day attendees
13 September 2026 - open 09:30-12:00 only, for the Arthur Rank Hospice 'Bridge the Gap' walk

queens.adult: £5.00 per visitor, self-guided, up to six people
queens.entrance: Visitors' Gate in Queens' Lane, or the Porters' Lodge on Silver Street if the Old Gate is shut
queens.groups: Six or more counts as a group at £5 each and must be led by a Cambridge Blue Badge Guide; parties without one are refused
queens.closedAlso: Christmas holidays and certain ceremonial days
queens.notOpen: President's Lodge, Old Library, War Memorial Library, Cripps Dining Hall, all rooms and staircases

licensing.authority: The Conservators of the River Cam
licensedStations: La Mimosa, corner of Jesus Green
Trinity College, inside the college grounds
The Mill Pond on Silver Street
The Granta mill pond near Sheep's Green
licensing.rule: Licensed companies only operate near their own punting station. Buy at a station.
licensing.touting: A Public Spaces Protection Order prohibits touting for punt custom anywhere in Cambridge. Breach is a criminal offence carrying a £100 fixed penalty notice or prosecution; uniformed enforcement officers and police patrol for it. Unlicensed operators sell on King's Parade and Market Square.
licensing.codeOfPractice: Companies at the authorised stations have signed a voluntary code limiting touting to areas near their own station, limiting the number of touts and requiring them to be identifiable.

stations: Mill Lane Punting Station, Granta Place, Mill Lane, CB2 1RS
Quayside Punting Station, Magdalene Bridge, CB5 8AB

sharedChauffeured.length: 45 minutes, returning to the same station
sharedChauffeured.soldBy: The row or section, not per head - a row of up to 2, a row of up to 3, a section of up to 4, a section of up to 6
sharedChauffeured.boat: Up to 12 passengers on 4 benches; babies and toddlers count
sharedChauffeured.kiosk: On-the-day kiosk prices vary from online prices for chauffeured tours

privateChauffeured.grantchesterOneWay: from £284, by phone or email only
privateChauffeured.puntAndWalk: from £220, 45-minute private punt plus a 60-minute private walking tour, 105 minutes combined, booked 48 hours ahead

selfHireCollegeBacks.deposit: Contactless card hire deposit at check-in, plus a signed Conditions of Hire
selfHireCollegeBacks.minAge: 16 to hire without an adult; under-16s must be with an adult of 18+
selfHireCollegeBacks.kiosk: On-the-day kiosk prices are the same as online prices for self-hire
selfHireCollegeBacks.restriction: College Backs hires run between Mill Lane and Quayside and cannot go upriver to Grantchester

selfHireGrantchester.overtime: £3.50 per 6 minutes for a 6-person punt, £7 for a 13-person punt

scudamores.cancellation: Refunds up to 48 hours ahead less an admin fee of 30% of the booking capped at £50; no refunds inside 48 hours except in dangerous conditions. Rescheduling is free up to 1 hour before departure.
scudamores.accessibility: Wheelchair access at Mill Lane only; pets allowed on shared tours subject to other passengers

fitzwilliamMuseum.admission: Free, including the collections and displays
fitzwilliamMuseum.hours: Tuesday to Saturday 10:00-17:00, Sunday 12:00-17:00, last entry 16:40. Closed Mondays.
fitzwilliamMuseum.exhibitions: Ticketed exhibitions are free for under-18s; pay what you can on the first Sunday of the month; free for 18-25s and students who join the Fitz List
fitzwilliamMuseum.groups: £5 per person for groups of 10 or more, excluding UK schools and universities
fitzwilliamMuseum.bags: Bags over 40 x 26 x 15cm must be carried or put in a locker; lockers take a £1 coin or a free token from the desk
fitzwilliamMuseum.address: Trumpington Street, CB2 1RB. No visitor parking.

botanicGarden.adultAdvance: £7.74, a 10% discount for booking up to a day ahead
botanicGarden.adultWithDonation: £9.50 on the gate, £8.64 in advance - the donation version is the one the site shows first
botanicGarden.free: Friends of CUBG, University of Cambridge students, essential carers
botanicGarden.hours: Open every day except the Christmas closure. February-March 10:00-17:00, April-September 10:00-18:00, October 10:00-17:00, November-January 10:00-16:00. Last paid admission 30 minutes before closing.
botanicGarden.gates: Brookside Gate on Trumpington Road and Station Road Gate on Hills Road
botanicGarden.advanceCaveat: The advance discount does not apply on special event days such as Apple Day and Cambridge Botanic Lights

roundChurch.admission: Not free - £3.50 standard, £1.00 teenagers and students
roundChurch.freeEntry: Cambridge and Anglia Ruskin students, Cambridge residents in CB1-CB5, children under 13 with a responsible adult
roundChurch.hours: Wednesday to Saturday 10:00-17:00, last entry 16:45; Monday and Tuesday vary by season; closed Sundays
roundChurch.whatItIs: 12th-century round church, founded between 1114 and 1131, one of four surviving medieval round churches in England; exhibition plus a 23-minute film narrated by Sir David Suchet
roundChurch.booking: No online booking and no need to book unless a group of more than 10; cash or card on arrival
roundChurch.guidedWalk: £16 standard, £14 students and 13-18s, under-13s free; 90 minutes to 2 hours; includes entry to the church; meets inside the Round Church; small online booking fee

market.hours: 10:00-16:00 every day except Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Year's Day
market.what: Street food and ingredients, art, plants, clothes, jewellery, books, music

orchardTeaGarden.publishedWinterHours: Wednesday to Sunday 10:00-16:00, weather permitting - the notice on the site dates from October 2022, so worth a call
orchardTeaGarden.bookings: No bookings for brunch, lunch, morning coffee or cream teas unless a party of 10 or more
orchardTeaGarden.servedOutside: Under the fruit trees in late spring, summer and early autumn; indoors in the Rupert Brooke Room otherwise

ownWalks: Orchard Tea Garden to Byron's Pool, approx 2km, past The Old Vicarage and the Rupert Brooke statue
Orchard Tea Garden to Grantchester Meadows, approx 3.5km, river path and kissing gates, returning past the Red Lion and the Green Man
grantchester.byPunt: Scudamore's Grantchester self-hire goes upriver past Sheep's Green and the Paradise Nature Reserve; College Backs hires may not go that way

freeAndCheap.otherFree: The Backs, Jesus Green, Midsummer Common and Parker's Piece are all free and open. Trinity's Wren Library is free in term time. King's chapel services are free.

twoForOne.scheme: National Rail 2FOR1 via Days Out Guide, which needs a National Rail ticket - not Oyster or contactless

cambridgeOffers.attraction: Rutherford's Punting Cambridge, shared punting experience

cambridgeOffers.offer: Discounted tickets, amount not stated in the page title
Listed on Days Out Guide but free anyway, and no discount named

twoForOne.notCovered: No college is in the scheme, and Scudamore's is not either.

getYourGuide.method: Each id fetched at https://www.getyourguide.com/activity/-t{id} and checked for a 200, the right title, and a rating.

Cambridge Walk & Punt Tour by Alumni, optional King's College
Cambridge University: Guided Punting Tour on the River Cam

verifiedNotUsed.title: Cambridge: Bridge of Sighs Punting Tour
Cambridge English Punting Tour with Student Guides

403 behind Cloudflare, so the title and rating could not be confirmed

notVerified: King's College closures during the April-June examination term. The college sells tickets on a rolling weekly window that only reached 1 November 2026 when checked, so there is no published spring calendar to read.
Walking distance and time from central Cambridge to Grantchester. The Orchard Tea Garden publishes distances for its own circular walks but not for the route in from the city.
Driving time from central London. No primary source gives one; National Express puts the road distance at about 106km.
Per-person price for a Scudamore's shared chauffeured tour. The booking widget sells rows and sections and its price API could not be read, so only the site's own 'from' figures are recorded.
Whether the Cambridge Bike Tour offer on Days Out Guide is 2FOR1 or a percentage - the page title says only 'Discounted tickets'.
